functions.function_requirement:
Function Name: calculate_simple_gpa
Description: Calculate cumulative GPA for university student
functions.user_input: Create a function called calculate_simple_gpa that takes a University object and student_id. For each enrollment from university.get_student_enrollments(student_id), get the course using university.get_course(enrollment.course_code), multiply enrollment.get_grade_points() by course.credits, sum all points and credits, return total_points / total_credits as GPA (0.0-4.0).
